title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasising on protecting and nurturing nature for the welfare and prosperity of all
body_text:
The Prime Minister,  Shri Narendra Modi today shared Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasising on the importance of protecting and nurturing nature for the welfare and prosperity of all: पालयन् प्रकृतिं राजा सुखी भवति नान्यथा। प्रकृतिश्च हिता यस्य स राजा सर्वकामधुक्॥ The verse conveys that a ruler who safeguards nature and works for its well-being ensures happiness and prosperity. Nature, in turn, fulfils the aspirations of those who protect and nurture it. The Prime Minister posted on X: पालयन् प्रकृतिं राजा सुखी भवति नान्यथा। प्रकृतिश्च हिता यस्य स राजा सर्वकामधुक्॥ पालयन् प्रकृतिं राजा सुखी भवति नान्यथा।

प्रकृतिश्च हिता यस्य स राजा सर्वकामधुक्॥ https://t.co/vWlZwpNEI0 — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) October 28, 2026 **** MJPS/SS/VJ
